revision: Deep Star Maps2020 celestial Milky Way background; official EXR snapshot
coordinateFrame: ICRF/J2000 geocentric RA/Dec; approximate EQJ frame shared with star catalog
epoch: static catalog-derived background, approximateJ2000; not a simulated date observation
projection: plate carrée / equirectangular equatorial, not galactic

toneMapping.encoding: IEC61966-2-1 standard linear-to-sRGB transfer; nearest integer8bit
toneMapping.resampling: Tone-map source once, then common LDR master Lanczos downsample to2K/1K; no per-resolution normalization

brightStarSeparation.backgroundContains: GaiaDR2 unresolved faint stars, supporting faint UCAC3 replacements, stellar clusters and Magellanic Clouds; no added nebulosity photography
brightStarSeparation.photometricGap: Runtime selectable catalog mostlyV<=6.5; omitted NASA foreground extends toV11.5. Integrated contribution from much of6.5..11.5 is therefore absent, except required catalog endpoints. This is not complete Milky Way luminosity or calibrated total sky brightness.
brightStarSeparation.limitation: Catalog/pipeline separation, not a custom6.5mag raster cutoff. V/G passband differences, blends/variables and supplemental stars prevent claiming mathematically zero residual bright-star contribution.

directionAnchors.sourceCoordinateText: J2000 RA17h45m40s Dec-29°00′28.00″; rounded reference direction, not subarcsecond astrometry
directionAnchors.pixelCoordinateConvention: pixel centers at integer coordinates; continuous x=u*width-.5,y=v*height-.5
